evaluate: (async()=>{const x=window.kaminosWorkbenchExperiments;window.__saved=await x.invoke('saveRegistration','Browser round-trip witness · October 23');await x.close();await x.open('part-claims',{sourceUrl:window.__saved.registration.recipe.sourceUrl,targetUrl:window.__saved.registration.recipe.targetUrl,registrationId:window.__saved.registration.id});const s=await x.read();return {alignmentKept:JSON.stringify(s.alignment)===JSON.stringify(window.__saved.registration.recipe.settings.alignment),guessesKept:s.joints.every(j=>JSON.stringify(j.guessPose)===JSON.stringify(window.__saved.registration.recipe.jointGuesses[j.id])),preview:s.preview}})()
